integrity: The analytical proof, exact rational root bounds, supporting normalization and an executable standard-library arithmetic checker are included. The reported review is same-model, not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only for a specified one-parameter icosahedrally symmetric family in the post-rhombic range. No global 32-vertex Mahler-optimality claim. The numerical gain is small, although strictness follows from exact signs. Historical priority remains provisional due to incomplete full-text access.
title: A unique non-spherical Mahler maximum along the post-rhombic icosahedral hull
